Step III: The 'Arrow' are getting shaded in alternate images and getting rotated.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f57e1c07970ee366d4238b8cde548efd08d4e1dc930fe182c29cb212f8d7bf1c.png]
